# War Scroll Column 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 5 | **Condition:** complete

---

**5:1** The cavalry [...] on the right and left flanks of the battle line. Horsemen are to be deployed on both sides of the line. The total cavalry force: six thousand —

**5:2** five hundred from each tribe. The cavalry who ride out with the infantry into battle must be courageous men, between thirty and forty-five years old.

**5:3** The mounted riders must be between forty and fifty years old. Both riders and horses are to wear body armor, helmets, and leg guards,

**5:4** and carry round shields, a spear eight cubits long, a bow with arrows, and a combat dagger.

**5:5** Every one of them must be single-minded in purpose — ready to cut down those God has marked for death. The cavalry of the fighting force will be stationed near the bulls designated for

**5:6** the burnt offering — twelve bulls. The chiefs of [...] will stay beside the bulls at all times. The cavalry regulations: they are to choose from every tribe of Israel

**5:7** brave men for the cavalry, and prepare horses for them that are fast, responsive to the reins, with excellent endurance and fully trained —

**5:8** experienced runners, ridden by skilled horsemen. Riders must be between thirty and forty-five years old. The cavalry of the battle line must be between

**5:9** forty and fifty years old. They [...] the saddle blankets. The horses must be fitted with coats of

**5:10** chain mail, helmets, and leg armor. The riders will carry shields [...] and a lance eight cubits long. The bow,

**5:11** arrows, and combat dagger will be strapped to their waists. All of these will ride mares [...] when the lot falls to them. No one who is

**5:12** lame, blind, or crippled may serve — no man with a lasting physical defect or with bodily impurity.

**5:13** None of these may go out to war with them. Every soldier must be a warrior — a volunteer, sound in mind and body. The holy

**5:14** angels will be present with their armies. No boy may be among them on the day of battle, because the holy angels are in their midst

**5:15** at all times. A buffer zone of about two thousand cubits must separate every camp from the latrine area, and nothing

**5:16** indecent may be visible anywhere around the camps. The camp officers must be between

**5:17** forty and fifty years old, and those who organize the camp, its equipment, and all supplies [...] must be capable, experienced men.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 5 provides detailed cavalry regulations: age brackets for different roles, weapons loadout, and horse selection. The horse criteria (fast, responsive, endurance, experienced) show genuine military expertise. The repeated purity requirements (5:12-15) underscore the theological conviction that holy angels fight alongside the human army — ritual contamination would drive away divine support. The text blends practical military planning with apocalyptic theology.*
